title: Patch: Stinkyscape balance changes II
notes: The owner's second Stinkyscape balance pass (R2657000-R2657006). Can't Defend is a keyword in place of the static flag "Can't be in Defense Position". A Field Trap reveals only on its first firing (trapFired.again). Float triggers only from the hand. A Trade never draws its own card back unless the deck holds no other. Summoning sickness persists through a refreshed attack. A Buff may add Flashback or remove Can't attack and Can't Defend; a Nerf may add Crater in a hand and never adds either. KY's Constant reads a Temporary count, Plague Counters and newly declared Unit and Trap amounts. Cost, stat and text changes to about forty cards; every changed script keeps its v0.5.9e version for replays (R767000).

changes: Float reduces a card's cost (or Tribute) only while it is in your hand, no longer in your deck.
A Field Trap reveals only the first time it fires. Later firings are quick triggers with no reveal, and "when one of your Traps reveals" no longer answers them.
Trading a card never draws that same card back unless it is the only card in your deck.
A Unit summoned this turn stays summoning sick even when an effect lets it attack again, so a refreshed Rush attack still can't hit the hero.
A Buff can give any card Flashback, or take Can't attack or Can't Defend off it. A Nerf can give Crater to a Unit, Field Spell or Trap in a hand, and never adds Can't attack or Can't Defend.
KY's Constant can change more numbers: a Temporary card's count, a card's Plague Counters, and printed amounts on Units and Traps such as Radix's Discover count or Bear Honeypot's tokens.
